title: IsArray Type
description:
Implement a conditional type `IsArray<T>` that evaluates to `true` when `T` is an array type, and `false` otherwise.

**Example:**
```ts
type A = IsArray<number[]>   // true
type B = IsArray<string>     // false
type C = IsArray<[1, 2, 3]>  // true (tuple is an array)
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using `T extends Array<infer U>` which is more verbose and the same. The simpler `T extends any[]` is idiomatic. Also note tuples extend `any[]` so they return true.
